scientific_review: Separate scientific pass checked historical chronology and evidence, lacI product versus cis operator, ligand specificity, negative regulation, repression/looping, occupancy and rates, partial-diploid allele predictions, controls and limits. Hypothetical values labelled. 18 arithmetic checks. Sources available as primary abstracts and textbooks, not every full paper.

Static markup inspected; no interactive device test.
comparator: 3.D.01 publication QA: 13,957 whitespace teaching words. This node: 14,307 whitespace words, 140 paragraphs, quantitative and genetic inference at comparable depth.
